answer: Every new identity must lock an opal deposit of 2,000 tokens in a shared lagoon before its first action counts. The deposit stays frozen for 90 days and only unlocks while the identity keeps producing work that peers accept. A hollow account that buys its way in and then does nothing forfeits the deposit to the pool. Running 10,000 fakes means freezing 20,000,000 tokens for three months and staffing every single one, so the fleet costs real capital and real hours before it earns anything.
